questions.stem: A linear model estimates the population of a city from $1992$ to $2016$. The model estimates the population was $61$ thousand in $1992$, $217$ thousand in $2012$, and $x$ thousand in $2016$. To the nearest whole number, what is the value of $x$?

An object's speed, in meters per hour, is increasing at a rate of $1, 490$ meters per hour per second. Which of the following is closest to this rate in feet per second squared? (Use $1$ meter $=$ $3.28$ feet.)

The measure of an angle is $(51)\left(\frac{k}{2}\right)\pi$ radians, where $k$ is a constant. What is the measure of this angle, in degrees?

A market researcher collected data on the price of an iced coffee at $42$ locations selected at random in a state.

The mean price of an iced coffee in the state was estimated to be $\$1.37$, with an associated margin of error of $\$0.05$. Which of the following is a plausible statement about the mean price of an iced coffee for all locations that sell this product in the state?

options.B: It is either less than $\$1.32$ or greater than $\$1.42$.
